title: Wonderful experience.
text: A beautiful, authentic and tranquil place. Highly recommend. Friendly helpful staff. Spa and treatment package recommended.
author: Christine_C

title: A wonder
text: If you want to enjoy an Arab spa with a relaxing space, aromas that transport you to other eras, and massages that leave you totally relaxed... This is your place. You come out feeling like new.
author: begonagr

title: Best human in Granada
text: What a fantastic experience. We were first given two towels and slippers and then taken to the changing rooms. Then we walked into the Harram. There were several pools of different temperatures, from cold to very hot. We spent time relaxing in them and moving from one to another. Later we had a massage. Mind was so relaxing. Throughout mint tea was available, delicious. We really enjoyed the experience.
author: Thargon

title: Not to miss when visiting Granada
text:
If your body is tired from the intensive walks in the city, or the weather is not cooperating, this is a great gift to yourself.
What a wonderful experience in this beautiful hammam with a serene atmosphere.
A real recommendation.
author: carolinee311

title: A beautiful, very relaxing moment
text:

Impeccable cleanliness

I will return without hesitation.
author: Decalco33

title: Beyond relaxing
text: Went in tired and stressed and came out the exact opposite-can’t recommend this experience highly enough
author: Pioneer11456989220

title: A great experience
text: A lovely relaxing end to a busy sightseeing holiday.  The baths were clean and peaceful.  The staff lovely and a good massage too.
author: Nathalie_W

title: Unforgettable experience
text: It was out of this world, I highly recommend it. The place is sparkling clean, the atmosphere is very inviting, you have to surrender all your senses and give in the experience, the decor is simple and yet sophisticated, the attention of the staff was on point. And the massage area and experience was everything I was waiting for. You have access to lockers to leave your belongings secured. They provide you with the escentials for a shower/shampoo combo and a blow dry for your hair so you won’t leave the place unkept, they give you a bag for your swimming suit so it won’t drip in your bag .
author: barandiaranperez

title: Amazing experience.
text: This may have been my favorite part of my 9 day Spanish vacation! We booked on the last morning of our trip,  so we done a ton of walking and the pampering was so appreciated. We booked the 45min bath/45 min massage.  You enter a world of calm - senses soothed from the ambient lighting and candles, relaxing music, the sound of running water, the teas offered and the fragrances.  There are 4 pools - a cold plunge, a warm bath, a warmer bath and one that’s a little more neutral.  There is also a sauna.  I did want to do the pool followed by the massage, but as others have mentioned, we were call
author: debg679

title: Relaxation and rejuvenation
text: What a unique experience while in beautiful Granada! After visiting Alhambra its decorations are decidedly copied after the palace. It was very luxurious and affordable!! Our massages were amazing!! We stupidly forgot our swimsuits because we got caught up with wine and tapas and they actually let us use some brand new ones of theirs!!!! I have not heard of such a thing. Would never happen in the US. I highly highly recommend this experience for anyone looking for relaxation and rejuvenation during their travels.
author: Mark_T
